capabilities: Navigate days, weeks, months and years through a sidebar calendar with editable overview pages
Manage task cards with nesting, carry-over, move-to-date and recurring tasks
Track goals and habits at day, week, month and year levels
Plan multi-day and repeating events plus projects with milestones
Write diary entries with pasted images and a focus mode
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README states it makes no network requests and stores everything as Markdown in a configurable Daybook folder, only editing the sections it manages.
intentEvidence: How it differs from Calendar, Periodic Notes and similar plugins
problem: Obsidian's daily notes only create and open dated notes from your own templates; there is no structured calendar with editable overviews, recurring tasks or habit tracking.

relations.evidence: How it differs from Calendar, Periodic Notes and similar plugins
Calendar and Periodic Notes open and create daily, weekly and monthly notes from your own templates
It only sees tasks in its own day notes, unlike plugins such as Tasks

summary: Calendar-based planner that gives day, week, month and year pages for tasks, goals, a diary, habits, events and projects in one place.
